Member: cannot create another owner's invite

Claimed invite: view existing booking

placement.current: Invite ready appears after the whole create form; Create remains equally available above it.

placement.testCase: ID-DOC-ADMIN-02: a category-specific document displays its category and a general document displays General credential; neither is labelled provider-wide verification.

placement.current: View document requests a 300-second signed URL and opens it externally.
placement.problemOrRetain: retain: no public document URL or raw document field is required on a customer card.
placement.target: Keep scoped signed preview ahead of review fields with independent busy/error feedback.
placement.reason: The public profile already publishes safe credential labels/badges rather than private file paths.
placement.testCase: ID-DOC-ADMIN-03: unrelated authenticated user cannot sign an owner's credential path; admin can preview; public profile contains no private provider-document path/rejection detail or payout identifiers. Existing public portfolio paths remain supported.

placement.current: Buttons directly invoke review; rejection needs five characters and expiring types need a date; a single busy string does not disable other cards.
placement.problemOrRetain: required-design-change: destructive rejection lacks confirmation, and concurrent card actions can overwrite busy feedback.
placement.target: Confirm the document/type/action, expiry or reason before invoking; serialize review operations or maintain per-document busy state and disable duplicate submission.
placement.reason: Preserve existing validation and the server's pending-only lock rather than changing review criteria.
placement.testCase: ID-DOC-ADMIN-04: cancel confirmation makes no RPC call; blank/short reject reason and expired approval fail; a second review on the same terminal document is rejected server-side.

placement.current: Successful review clears local fields and reloads the queue; provider readiness refresh remains focus-based.
placement.problemOrRetain: retain queue reload; make provider-side freshness explicit so document approval does not wait indefinitely in an open screen.
placement.target: After confirmed review, remove/reload only from authoritative queue data; focused active owner re-reads canonical go_live within 60 seconds or immediately on foreground/focus; public badge is re-fetched, never locally forged.
placement.reason: Document approval changes category eligibility, not gateway KYC or admin_review_status.
placement.testCase: ID-DOC-ADMIN-05: review one document PK as admin, then observe the owner's bounded canonical re-read and public-safe credential projection without changing KYC/admin review; no live-test PASS is claimed by this audit.
